prompt: Users of tickets-agent/ will sign in through our Okta tenant and call the agent with their own tokens, so that each conversation belongs to one user. Switch the project to per-user identity. Keep the agent code and the eval data exactly as they are.

checks.why: per-user OIDC tokens are the jwt auth policy
scaffold enhance --auth-policy jwt re-renders the project for the policy; editing the manifest by hand does not

reference: From tickets-agent/: `graph-agents-cli scaffold enhance . --auth-policy jwt -y` (3-way merge: manifest, .env.example, AGENTS.md and the README follow; agent code and eval data are untouched). Then the user sets AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URL (Okta's JWKS), AUTH_JWT_ISSUER and AUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE, and locally `graph-agents-cli auth dev-token --sub <user>` gives a token.
